courses.title: Residential Electrical Foundations (NEC 2023)
courses.delivery_status: all four stages can run in this bundle
courses.wiring_gap: modules 2-5 are unwired: no simulator, class station or lesson in this bundle practises grounding and bonding, conductor sizing, device wiring or lockout/tagout; the only electricians sim (boom-lift) and lesson (electricians-clip-in-first) teach aerial-lift basket work, which no module of this course covers, and the bas-controls, fire-alarm and instrumentation halls bind only the same systems crib

modules.title: Ohm's Law, Circuits and Meter Use

stages.text: Read on series vs parallel circuits and watch a CAT III multimeter walkthrough; 10-question check on V=IR and P=VI.

Sim bench: measure voltage, continuity and resistance on a live-dead-live test sequence without skipping the proving step.
Virtual job site: troubleshoot a dead bedroom receptacle traced to an open neutral on a backstabbed device.

modules.wiring_note: the module practises measuring voltage, continuity and resistance; the systems crib drill (bound to the electricians hall) asks for the tool that reads voltage, current and resistance in one instrument - the multimeter. stages.text: Short reading on equipment grounding conductor vs grounded conductor, main bonding jumper and grounding electrode system.

Sim rough-in: drill studs, staple NM cable within 12 in. of boxes, box fill calculation per 314.16.
Finish trim-out of a kitchen with 20 A small-appliance circuits and GFCI/AFCI where required; pass the sim inspection.
Watch a module on line vs load terminals and 3-way/4-way switching.

Order 6 shuffled LOTO steps and identify the missing verification of zero energy.
Sim: apply personal lock and tag on a 200 A disconnect, test-before-touch with a proven meter.
Sam runs a surprise energized-equipment scenario; any skipped step ends the attempt and triggers a debrief.
